name: Seiki ~Ryoujoku no Kamen~
source: The protagonist is a high school student who has been bullied daily. One day a mysterious man sells him a magical mask that promises to bring happiness to the wearer, until he discovers later that the true nature of the mask is to empower the wearer to avenge against enemies...
translation: 主人公是一名每天都遭受霸凌的高中生。一天，一名神秘男子卖给他一副魔法面具，声称面具能为佩戴者带来幸福。直到后来，主人公才发现面具真正的力量，是让佩戴者获得向仇敌复仇的能力……
